thread:
Marta L.: Heads up — Helios AG (acct 3322) Feb invoice shows no reserved-capacity credit lines; invoice total is $27,918 higher than portal. Can someone look?

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-06-10T09:12:03Z finished with 1 WARN. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with missing credit lines. job id job_20260610_0912

Ben C.: Which invoice id? PDF/raw?

Marta L.: INV-2026-02-3322. Raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/02/INV-2026-02-3322.json PDF: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-02-3322.pdf

Omar R.: Pulling the payload. I see usage rows include reserved_pool_hours but the join to credit_profiles seems to be filtered earlier by an inner join in the materialized view. Suspect a recent change to the mv definition.

Omar R.: Snippet from billing_mv (trimmed):
```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW billing_mv AS
SELECT u.account_id, u.hours, cp.credit_amount
FROM usage u
JOIN credit_profiles cp ON cp.account_id = u.account_id
-- previous version used LEFT JOIN to include accounts without profiles
```

Nina (Acct): Also noticed a duplicate invoice record: INV-2026-02-3322 and INV-2026-02-3322-dup both created. Payment NOT captured. Please hold autopay and don't void yet until we reconcile.

Marta L.: Hold applied to both invoice IDs. billing-bot, please log invoice_hold.

billing-bot: action logged: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-02-3322 and INV-2026-02-3322-dup by Marta L. at 2026-06-10T09:20:45Z

Ben C.: Plan: (1) revert MV change to LEFT JOIN (or COALESCE cp.credit_amount,0), (2) refresh materialized view, (3) re-run invoice generation for acct 3322 only, (4) void duplicate draft and create credit memo if needed. I'll open hotfix PR.

Omar R.: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/billing-mv/pulls/77 — revert to LEFT JOIN and add unit test asserting reserved_pool_hours result when cp is NULL. Requesting hotfix deploy to staging.

Ben C.: To reprocess:
```bash
billing-reprocess --account 3322 --period 2026-02 --mode regenerate --reason "missing reserved credits from mv"
```

Nina (Acct): Meanwhile CS asked for something tangible to show Helios: please create a provisional negative line item representing expected credit $27,918.00 and link to both invoices.

Marta L.: Created provisional credit PC-2026-06-0012 for $27,918.00 linked to INV-2026-02-3322 and INV-2026-02-3322-dup. Noted on account.

billing-bot: finance-ops ticket created: FIN-5076 "Helios AG missing reserved capacity credits + duplicate invoice" assigned to Billing Ops.

Omar R.: Deployed MV fix to staging, refreshed MV, tests green. Pushing to prod now.

Ben C.: Prod MV refresh completed at 2026-06-10T10:05:12Z. Kicking off reprocess job job_reproc_3322_202602.

billing-bot: job_reproc_3322_202602 completed at 2026-06-10T10:28:01Z. Result: regenerated invoice uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/02/INV-2026-02-3322-corrected.pdf. Duplicate INV-2026-02-3322-dup voided.

Nina (Acct): Verified corrected invoice. Converted provisional credit PC-2026-06-0012 to official credit memo CM-2026-06-0044 and applied. Reached out to Helios CS and offered to reimburse any processing fees if they were charged.

Marta L.: Thanks team. Closing FIN-5076 after postmortem: (1) add migration checklist for MV schema changes, (2) add reconciliation alert for invoice vs usage delta > $5k, (3) improve duplicate-detection for invoice creation. :thumbsup:
